'''Caleb Joshua'''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Spotify |url=https://open.spotify.com/episode/4CvVtfVJ9bD8YdDtjEarop?si=K6KE0i__RlaBC4GW81R4dA&utm_source=copy-link |access-date=2026-08-22 |website=open.spotify.com |at=7m54s}}</ref> '''Hammer''' (born February 14, 1995) is an American [[YouTuber]] best known for hosting ''Financial Audit'', a show analyzing guests' personal finance.

== Early life and education ==
Hammer was born in [[Kalamazoo, Michigan]]<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Gordon |first=Lauren |date=2025-10-28 |title=Gov. Whitmer Lets YouTuber Caleb Hammer Audit Michigan State Budget |url=https://wkfr.com/caleb-hammer-michigan-budget/ |access-date=2025-11-25 |website=103.3 WKFR }}</ref> and raised in [[Portage, Michigan]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Spotify |url=https://open.spotify.com/episode/1xz2ft4051qsHHzz0VA0T1?si=LwQ3DzoPQoyuf7vK-bkmSg&utm_source=copy-link |access-date=2026-08-22 |website=open.spotify.com |at=5m05s}}</ref>. He describes his family life as average and not having a lot of money.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Dodgson |first=Lindsay |date=2023-04-24 |title=Finance YouTuber Caleb Hammer uses his past money struggles to help people fight their huge debts: 'I was in a really bad situation' |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/caleb-hammer-uses-own-past-money-problems-help-people-debt-2023-4 |access-date=2025-11-25 |website=Business Insider }}</ref> He briefly studied music composition at [[Western Michigan University]], but dropped out after his YouTube channel began to take off.<ref name=":0" />

== Career ==
In 2022, Hammer started posting his show, ''Financial Audit'', to [[YouTube]].<ref name=":1" /> The show analyzes guests' bank statements and debts to challenge their spending habits.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Dodgson |first=Lindsay |title=Caleb Hammer promised to save them from financial ruin — and it seems to actually be working |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/caleb-hammers-interviews-what-happened-next-2023-10 |access-date=2025-11-25 |website=Business Insider }}</ref> Within a year, his channel garnered over 360,000 subscribers, and his [[TikTok]] account hosting clips of the show grew to 250,000 followers.<ref name=":1" /> By November 2025, the channel had accumulated two billion views and become the biggest membership channel on the platform.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Grobar |first=Matt |date=2025-11-20 |title=CAA Signs 'Financial Audit's Caleb Hammer |url=https://deadline.com/2025/11/caleb-hammer-signs-caa-exclusive-1236625189/ |access-date=2025-11-25 |website=Deadline }}</ref> In the same month, Caleb Hammer signed with the [[Creative Artists Agency]].<ref name=":2" />

''Financial Audit'' hosted an appearance by Michigan governor [[Gretchen Whitmer]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hazard |first=Charlotte |date=2025-10-27 |title=Michigan Democratic Gov. Gretchen Whitmer to go on Financial Audit with Caleb Hammer |url=https://thenationaldesk.com/news/americas-news-now/financial-audit-caleb-hammer-michigan-democratic-governor-gretchen-whitmer-youtube-state-finances-assessment |access-date=2025-11-25 |website=The National Desk }}</ref> The interview covered Michigan's debt, [[Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program|food stamps]], and her own political leanings.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hazard |first=Charlotte |date=2025-11-03 |title=Youtuber Caleb Hammer confronts Michigan Gov. Whitmer on latest Financial Audit episode |url=https://thenationaldesk.com/news/americas-news-now/michigan-financial-audit-governor-gretchen-whitmer-caleb-hammer-youtube-finance-influencer-social-media |access-date=2025-11-25 |website=The National Desk }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-03 |title=Michigan Gov. Whitmer Dismisses Her COVID Lockdown As Host Grills Her On 'Inside Outside' Dining |url=https://www.tampafp.com/michigan-gov-whitmer-dismisses-her-covid-lockdown-as-host-grills-her-on-inside-outside-dining/ |access-date=2026-01-16 |website=Tampa Free Press|last=Bolden|first=Leslie}}</ref>

According to Ashley Carman writing for ''[[Bloomberg L.P.|Bloomberg]]'', Hammer is known for vocally berating his guests for their financial habits. She described his style of content as "an amalgamation of everything the internet seemingly loves: very online problems ([[OnlyFans]] subscriptions), public flogging (a la ''[[Kill Tony]]'') and framing that makes somewhat routine financial issues seem more scandalous than they actually are". Guests are vetted beforehand for interesting life stories, use fake names, and are compensated for travelling to his filming location in [[Austin, Texas]].<ref>{{cite web|title=The Jerry Springer of YouTube Turns Personal Finance Into an Entertaining Blood Sport|last1=Carmen|first1=Ashley|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2025-12-11/-financial-audit-podcaster-caleb-hammer-mines-drama-gold-from-financial-ruin|website=Bloomberg|date=December 11, 2025|access-date=February 16, 2026}}</ref>

Hammer has another channel called ''Front Page'' that was created in January 2024 and repurposed in February 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Front Page |url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCN6jLlWVXaBCbfSopYOId1g |access-date=2026-08-19 |website=YouTube |language=en}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
As of 2023, Hammer resides in [[Austin, Texas]].<ref name=":1" />

'''Durim Morina''' (born October 17, 1994), known professionally as '''Mirud''', is an American singer-songwriter. He participated in the [[Viña del Mar International Song Festival]] in 2019, and in several editions of [[Festivali i Këngës]].

==Early life and background==
Morina was born on October 17, 1994, in [[Los Angeles]], California to [[Kosovo Albanians|Kosovo Albanian]] parents.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-11 |title=Nga Los Angeles në Kosovë dhe sërish drejt botës, historia e vërtetë e Mirudit |url=https://rtv21.tv/nga-los-angeles-ne-kosove-dhe-serish-drejt-botes-historia-e-vertete-e-mirudit/ |access-date=2026-03-14 |website=RTV21 |language=sq}}</ref><ref name="Somos">{{cite news |date=December 27, 2025 |title=Mirud anuncia su nuevo álbum ''Desnudo'' y proyecta su mensaje artístico hacia Latinoamérica |url=https://somosoriente.com/mirud-anuncia-su-nuevo-album-desnudo-y-proyecta-su-mensaje-artistico-hacia-latinoamerica/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260131032238/https://somosoriente.com/mirud-anuncia-su-nuevo-album-desnudo-y-proyecta-su-mensaje-artistico-hacia-latinoamerica/ |archive-date=January 31, 2026 |website=Somos Oriente |language=es}}</ref><ref name="Chirino">{{Cite news |last=Chirino |first=Bárbara |date=January 10, 2026 |title=El cantante MIRUD estará en Eurovisión 2026 desde el Festival de San Marino |url=https://meridiano.net/farandula/el-cantante-mirud-estara-en-eurovision-2026-desde-el-festival-de-san-marino-2026110800 |access-date=2026-01-11 |website=Meridiano.net |language=es}}</ref> He started his musical career after graduating in opera studies from the [[Juilliard School]] in [[New York City|New York]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-12 |title=MIRUD: el primer ícono pop global de Albania |url=https://laprensatachira.com/nota.php?ic=46717&y=2025&m=11&tit=mirud--el-primer--icono-pop-global-de-albania |access-date=2026-01-04 |website=La Prensa Táchira |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Kush është Mirud |url=https://topawards.top-channel.tv/artist/mirud/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=Top Channel |language=sq}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{cite web |title=Kush është Mirud, hyrja më e re e The Top List |url=https://topawards.top-channel.tv/kush-eshte-mirud-hyrja-me-e-re-e-the-top-list/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=Top Channel |language=sq}}</ref>

==Career==
Morina began releasing original music in the late 2010s.<ref>{{cite news |date=1 October 2018 |title=The young singer Durim Morina brings the song performed by the producer of Justin Bieber |url=https://telegrafi.com/en/New-singer-Durim-Morina-brings-the-song-performed-by-Justin-Bieber-video-producer/ |access-date=2026-03-14 |website=Telegrafi}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=November 15, 2018 |title=Kosovar singer with international fame part of RTSH Festival |url=https://indeksonline.net/en/Kosovar-singer-with-international-fame-part-of-the-song-festival-on-RTSH/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=Indeksonline}}</ref> He has appeared in interviews or music segments on several broadcasters.<ref name=":3">{{cite web |title=Mirud tregon se pse nuk mori pjesë në Këngën Magjike këtë vit |url=https://rtv21.tv/mirud-tregon-se-pse-nuk-mori-pjese-ne-kengen-magjike-kete-vit/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=RTV21 |language=sq}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Mirud tregon për TAR gjithçka rreth këngës "Për dreq" |url=https://www.topalbaniaradio.com/mirud-tregon-per-tar-gjithcka-rreth-kenges-per-dreq-si-dhe-risia-qe-artisti-pritet-te-sjelle-ne-festivalin-e-kenges/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=Top Albania Radio |language=sq}}</ref>
[[File:Photo_of_MIRUD_performing_at_Festivali_I_Kenges_57.jpg|alt=|thumb|upright=0.8|Mirud performing at [[Festivali i Këngës 57]] in 2018]]
In 2018, he participated in the [[Festivali i Këngës 57|57th Festivali i Këngës]], an Albanian music festival, but was eliminated during the semi-final with the song "Nënë".<ref>{{cite news |date=October 20, 2018 |title=Festivali i 57-të në RTSH, shpallet lista e këngëtarëve |url=https://www.botasot.info/muzike-kultura/967797/festivali-i-57-te-ne-rtsh-shpallet-lista-e-kengetareve-qe-do-marrin-pjese/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=Bota Sot |language=sq}}</ref> The following year, he represented Albania at the 60th edition of the [[Viña del Mar International Song Festival]] in Chile, one of the first Kosovar artists to be invited to compete there.<ref>{{Cite news |date=April 14, 2019 |title=Mirud will perform in Albanian in Chile |url=https://telegrafi.com/en/Nice-to-perform-in-Albanian-in-Chile/ |access-date=2025-12-27 |website=Telegrafi}}</ref>

In 2020, he competed again at [[Festivali i Këngës 59]], performing the song "Nëse vdes".<ref name="Conchita">{{cite web |date=December 23, 2020 |title=Conchita shqiptare? Durim Morina këndon në festival i veshur me fustan |url=https://www.gazetaexpress.com/conchita-shqiptare-durim-morina-kendon-ne-festival-i-veshur-me-fustan/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=Gazeta Express |language=sq}}</ref> He was forced to withdraw from the 2021 [[Kënga Magjike 2021|Kënga Magjike]] after testing positive for [[COVID-19]], but later that year reached the final of [[Albania in the Eurovision Song Contest 2021|Festivali i Këngës 60]] with "Për dreq".<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{cite news |title=Mirud tregon për TAR gjithçka rreth këngës 'Për dreq' |url=https://www.topalbaniaradio.com/mirud-tregon-per-tar-gjithcka-rreth-kenges-per-dreq-si-dhe-risia-qe-artisti-pritet-te-sjelle-ne-festivalin-e-kenges/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=Top Albania Radio |language=sq}}</ref>

In December 2025, Mirud announced the forthcoming release of his studio album ''Desnudo'' in Latin America.<ref>{{cite news |date=December 2025 |title=Mirud lanza Desnudo, un álbum íntimo y emocional |url=https://noticiassin.com/mirud-lanza-desnudo-un-album-intimo-y-emocional-2024450 |website=Noticias SIN |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=December 28, 2025 |title=Mirud fortalece su presencia en el mercado latino con 'Desnudo' |url=https://elnuevodiario.com.do/mirud-fortalece-su-presencia-en-el-mercado-latino-con-desnudo/ |website=El Nuevo Diario |language=es}}</ref>

In 2026, following his appearance at the San Marino music festival, Mirud was confirmed as a participant in the auditions stage of ''San Marino Song Contest'', the national selection process used to choose San Marino's representative for the [[Eurovision Song Contest 2026]].<ref>{{cite news |date=January 6, 2026 |title=Mirud confirma Eurovision 2026 desde el Festival de San Marino |url=https://www.elcaribe.com.do/gente/mirud-confirma-eurovision-2026-desde-el-festival-de-san-marino/ |website=El Caribe |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=January 6, 2026 |title=Mirud se proyecta a Eurovision 2026 tras sumarse al Festival de San Marino |url=https://lanacionweb.com/farandula-y-espectaculos/mirud-se-proyecta-a-eurovision-2026-tras-sumarse-al-festival-de-san-marino/ |website=La Nación |language=es}}</ref> However, it was reported that after the success of his 2026 album ''Desnudo'', he withdrew from the contest.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-02-09 |title=Mirud participa en la 68.ª edición de los premios Grammy y lanza álbum Desnudo |url=https://noticiassin.com/mirud-participa-en-la-68-edicion-de-los-premios-grammy-y-lanza-album-desnudo-2030526/ |access-date=2026-03-18 |website=Noticias SIN |language=es}}</ref>
[[File:Photo of MIRUD appearance at Festivali I Kenges 59.jpg|alt=|thumb|upright=0.8|Mirud at Festivali i Këngës 59 in 2020]]

==Public image==
Following Mirud's appearance at Festivali i Këngës 59 in 2020, his staging and costume were criticized on [[social media]];<ref>{{cite news |title=The young Albanian artist Mirud steals attention with extravagant outfit |url=https://telegrafi.com/en/the-young-Albanian-artist-Mirud-steals-the-attention-extravagant-outfit-at-the-rtsh-festival-that-is-criticized-by-followers-on-social-networks/ |access-date=2025-01-01 |website=Telegrafi}}</ref> he addressed the comments on ''[[Televizioni Klan|TvKlan]]''.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=2020-12-23 |title=Kërcënohet me vdekje këngëtari shqiptar për shkak të veshjes |url=https://tvklan.al/kercenohet-me-vdekje-kengetari-shqiptar-per-shkak-te-veshjes-se-tij-ne-festivalin-e-kenges |access-date=2025-11-29 |website=TvKlan |language=sq}}</ref>

Alumni Panel |url=https://www.torontomu.ca/fashion/stories-events/2022/09/welcome-back--alumni-panel/ |date=2022-08-30 |access-date=2026-01-16 |website=[[Toronto Metropolitan University]]}}</ref>

'''Van Goth''' is the stage name of '''Blake Harris''' (born December 18, 1997),<ref>{{Cite web |last=Baumgartner |first=Alex |date=2022-11-15 |title=Onstage and Offstage, these Queens are Family - On The Record |url=https://ontherecordnews.ca/onstage-and-offstage-these-queens-are-family/ |access-date=2026-01-16 |language=en-US}}</ref> a Canadian [[Drag (entertainment)|drag]] performer who won the [[Canada's Drag Race season 6|sixth season]] of ''[[Canada's Drag Race]]''. In 2026 Van Goth was announced as a cast member of the fourth season of [[The Traitors Canada]] alongside season 2 winner [[Icesis Couture]], marking the first time in Traitors history that 2 drag queens competed on the same season.

== Early life and career ==
Blake Harris was born and raised in [[Richmond Hill, Ontario]]. He attended [[St. Elizabeth Catholic High School]]'s Regional Arts Program with a focus in acting, and then [[Toronto Metropolitan University]] with a major in fashion design. He began performing in drag at age 20 and won [[Scarlett Bobo]]'s [[Absolut Vodka|Absolut]] Empire's Ball in 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ontherecordnews.ca/onstage-and-offstage-these-queens-are-family/ |title=Onstage and Offstage, these Queens are Family |last=Baumgartner |first=Alex |website=ontherecordnews.ca |publisher=[[On the Record (newspaper)|On the Record]] |access-date=January 21, 2026}}</ref><ref name="tmu"/>

During his time on ''[[Canada's Drag Race]]'', Van Goth won multiple challenges,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-12 |title='Canada's Drag Race' Season 6, Episode 4 recap: Battle it out |url=https://xtramagazine.com/culture/canadas-drag-race-season-6-episode-4-recap-278749 |access-date=2026-01-16 |website=[[Xtra Magazine]] |language=en-CA |archive-date=2025-12-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251225030535/https://xtramagazine.com/culture/canadas-drag-race-season-6-episode-4-recap-278749 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-02 |title='Canada's Drag Race' Season 6, Episode 7 power ranking: The final five {{!}} Xtra Magazine |url=https://xtramagazine.com/culture/drag-race/canadas-drag-race-season-6-episode-7-power-ranking-279164 |access-date=2026-01-16 |language=en-CA |archive-date=2026-01-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260107205323/https://xtramagazine.com/culture/drag-race/canadas-drag-race-season-6-episode-7-power-ranking-279164 |url-status=live }}</ref> including the first of the season.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-21 |title='Canada's Drag Race' Season 6, Episode 1 power ranking: Forever your girls |url=https://xtramagazine.com/culture/drag-race/canadas-drag-race-season-6-episode-1-power-ranking-278143 |access-date=2026-01-16 |website=[[Xtra Magazine]] |language=en-CA}}</ref>

In June 2026, she was cohost of Toronto's annual AIDS Candlelight Vigil.<ref>[https://www.torontotoday.ca/local/more-news/toronto-aids-candlelight-vigil-tonight-barbara-hall-park-12458833 "Toronto AIDS candlelight vigil to be held tonight at Barbara Hall Park"]. ''[[Village Media|Toronto Today]]'', June 23, 2026.</ref> In September, he is slated to appear in the fourth season of ''[[The Traitors Canada]]''.<ref>[https://www.iheartradio.ca/en/music-news/justin-biebers-dad-is-joining-season-4-of-the-traitors-canada/ "Justin Bieber’s Dad Is Joining Season 4 of ‘The Traitors Canada’"]. ''[[iHeartRadio Canada]]'', September 9, 2026.</ref>

== Personal life ==
Harris is based in [[Toronto]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sim |first=Bernardo |title=Canada's Drag Race season 6: Meet the 12 new queens {{!}} Out.com |url=https://www.out.com/gay-tv-shows/canadas-drag-race-season-6-meet-the-queens |access-date=2026-01-16 |website=www.out.com |language=en}}</ref> He studied [[fashion]].<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |last2= |first2= |last3= |first3= |last4= |first4= |last5= |first5= |last6= |first6= |date=2025-11-20 |title=3 Toronto queens to appear on 'Canada's Drag Race' |url=https://www.torontotoday.ca/local/arts-culture/3-toronto-queens-canadas-drag-race-11513418 |access-date=2026-01-16 |website=TorontoToday.ca |language=en}}</ref>

He is of partial [[Acadians|Acadian]] ancestry, with roots in [[Clare, Nova Scotia]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=74. Mya Foxx Sold Us Cell Phones - Shootin' the Sh!t with Tracy & Martina |url=https://open.spotify.com/episode/6nlelUowEgBKjgQFvosNQo |date=2025-11-25 |access-date=2026-01-16 |website=[[Spotify]]}}</ref> During his time on ''Canada's Drag Race'', Harris revealed he is [[HIV-positive people|HIV-positive]].<ref>{{Cite Instagram |postid=DSc8Wz5DhqR |user=itsvangoth |title=I don't know how to begin...  My look is a message about the laws that govern and often times unjustly target queer people living with HIV. Being undetectable has changed my life but still in our justice system peoples statuses are used against them in the court of law. |date=2025-12-19}}</ref> Harris is a former [[Rugby union|rugby]] player who has described Van Goth as a "showgirl rockstar".<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-11-21 |title='Canada's Drag Race' Season 6 premiere recap: Girl, don't play the fool |url=https://xtramagazine.com/culture/drag-race/canadas-drag-race-season-6-premiere-recap-278111 |access-date=2026-01-16 |website=Xtra Magazine |language=en-CA |archive-date=2025-12-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251209081013/https://xtramagazine.com/culture/drag-race/canadas-drag-race-season-6-premiere-recap-278111 |url-status=live }}</ref>

'''Lourdes Alameda Garcia-Moreno''' (born 29 July 1991) is a Spanish [[rugby union]] player. She has competed for {{nwrut|Spain}} in the [[2014 Women's Rugby World Cup|2014]], [[2017 Women's Rugby World Cup|2017]] and [[2025 Women's Rugby World Cup|2025 Women's Rugby World Cups]].

== Early career ==
Alameda first participated in [[rhythmic gymnastics]] at the age of three, she later took part in other sports like [[tennis]] and [[badminton]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=2019-05-24 |title=La leona Lourdes Alameda en el debate Mujeres excepcionales de BBVA |url=https://ferugby.es/la-leona-lourdes-alameda-en-el-debate-mujeres-excepcionales-de-bbva/ |url-status=live |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=Real Federación Española de Rugby - FERugby - Spanish Rugby Union |language=es}}</ref>

She first got involved with [[Rugby union|rugby]] at 18 while attending the [[Complutense University of Madrid]] in 2009.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Isaac |first=Francisco |date=2025-05-09 |title=Lourdes Alameda: 'I lost the will to talk or leave my home, but I have zero regrets' |url=https://www.rugbypass.com/news/lourdes-alameda-i-lost-the-will-to-talk-or-leave-my-home-but-i-have-zero-regrets/ |url-status=live |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=www.rugbypass.com |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date=2020-04-07 |title=La vida de Alameda y Rico fuera de España |url=https://www.latribunadetoledo.es/noticia/z53f89df7-0809-de5d-b4fb23ddd46ec88f/202004/la-vida-de-alameda-y-rico-fuera-de-espana |url-status=live |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=La Tribuna de Toledo |language=spanish}}</ref> She intended to play [[handball]] in college but there wasn't a women's league.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Soro |first=Mario |date=2018-02-09 |title=Lourdes Alameda: "Nos hacen comentarios hirientes por jugar a rugby" |url=https://www.heraldo.es/noticias/deportes/2018/02/09/lourdes-alameda-nos-hacen-comentarios-hirientes-por-jugar-rugby-1223835-307.html |url-status=live |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=heraldo.es |language=es}}</ref> There were other sports to choose from but rugby caught her attention. She knew she wanted to play rugby because she knew nothing about it.<ref name=":3" />

==Rugby career==
Alameda earned her first cap in the [[2013 Women's European Qualification Tournament|2013 European Qualification Tournament]] for the [[2014 Women's Rugby World Cup|2014 World Cup]], she played in the final 20 minutes in {{nwrut|Spain}}’s victory over the {{nwrut|Netherlands}}.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Noguera |first=Jorge |date=2025-08-09 |title=La paradoja de las Leonas mundialistas: “Hemos mejorado mucho, pero nos falta nivel” |url=https://as.com/masdeporte/polideportivo/la-paradoja-de-las-leonas-mundialistas-hemos-mejorado-mucho-pero-nos-falta-nivel-n/ |url-status=live |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=Diario AS |language=es}}</ref>

She has played in two [[Women's Rugby World Cup|Rugby World Cups]], and has won the [[Rugby Europe Women's Championship|Rugby Europe Championship]] multiple times.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-07-22 |title=LU VUELVE A CASA |url=http://www.xvsansescrumrugby.com/2021/07/22/lu-vuelve-a-casa/ |url-status=live |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=Sanse Scrum Rugby |language=es-ES}}</ref> She has also competed for the [[Spain women's national rugby sevens team|Spanish sevens team]] in the [[Women's SVNS|Sevens World Series]].<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |date=2019-08-25 |title=Lourdes Alameda al AC Bobigny Rugby francés |url=https://www.rugbyfemenino.com.es/2019/08/25/lourdes-alameda-al-ac-bobigny-rugby-frances/ |url-status=live |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=Rugby Femenino |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Sánchez Carbonell |first=Ángel |date=2014-05-16 |title=Lourdes Alameda de nuevo con la Selección Española de Rugby |url=https://www.cronicanorte.es/lourdes-alameda-de-nuevo-con-la-seleccion-espanola-de-rugby/61490 |url-status=live |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=www.cronicanorte.es |language=es}}</ref>

She has previously played for the Sanse Scrum Rugby Club in [[San Sebastián de los Reyes]].<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-01 |title=Lourdes Alameda, del Sanse Rugby, se proclama campeona de Europa junto a sus compañeras de la selección española |url=https://www.cronicanorte.es/lourdes-alameda-del-sanse-rugby-se-proclama-campeona-de-europa-junto-a-sus-companeras-de-la-seleccion-espanola/172355 |url-status=live |access-date=2025-11-07 |language=es}}</ref> She first played for them in the 2011–2012 season.<ref name=":4" /><ref name=":5">{{Cite web |date=2019-08-25 |title=Lourdes Alameda ficha por AC Bobigny 93 Rugby |url=https://www.revista22.es/2019/08/lourdes-alameda-ficha-por-ac-bobigny-93-rugby/ |url-status=live |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=Veintidós |language=es}}</ref> In 2019, she joined French club, [[AC Bobigny 93 Women|AC Bobigny 93]], in the [[Élite 1]] competition.<ref name=":4" /><ref name=":5" />

In 2023, she got injured after a ruck and couldn’t move her head the following day. However, she continued playing and featured in matches against {{nwrut|Italy}} and the Netherlands. She was later told that she had contracted a [[Radiculopathy|cervical radiculopathy]] and had to go to the hospital for two months.<ref name=":0" />

Alameda was selected in Spain's squad for the [[2025 Women's Rugby World Cup]] in [[England]].<ref name="Spain">{{Cite web |date=11 August 2025 |title=Así será el equipo de 32 Leonas que representará a España en el Mundial de Inglaterra |trans-title=This is the 32-woman team that will represent Spain at the World Cup in England. |url=https://ferugby.es/asi-sera-el-equipo-de-32-leonas-que-representara-a-espana-en-el-mundial-de-inglaterra |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20250811133201/https://ferugby.es/asi-sera-el-equipo-de-32-leonas-que-representara-a-espana-en-el-mundial-de-inglaterra |archive-date=11 August 2025 |access-date=11 August 2025 |website=[[Spanish Rugby Federation]] |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=8 November 2025 |title=Spain announce squad for Women's RWC 2025 |url=https://www.rugbyworldcup.com/2025/en/news/1002236/spain-announce-squad-for-womens-rwc-2025 |access-date=14 August 2025 |website=Rugby World Cup 2025 England |language=en}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Alameda has a degree in [[Biology]].<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" />

pages.title: Killing of Rob and Michele Reiner

main.content:
{{Short description|2025 double homicide in Los Angeles, California, US}} {{use American English|date=December 2025}} {{use mdy dates|date=December 2025}} {{Infobox civilian attack | title = Killing of Rob and Michele Reiner | image = LBJ Library film screening group photo (4x5 cropped).jpg | caption = [[Michele Singer Reiner|Michele]] and [[Rob Reiner]] in 2016 | location = [[Brentwood, Los Angeles]],
California, US | coordinates = | date = December 14, 2025; {{Age in years and months|2025|12|14}} ago | type = [[Homicide]] | fatalities = 2 | victims = {{unbulleted list|[[Rob Reiner]]|[[Michele Singer Reiner]]}} | accused = Nick Reiner | charges = [[Murder in California law|First-degree murder]] with
[[special circumstances (criminal law)|special circumstances]] (×2) }} On December 14, 2025, American filmmaker [[Rob Reiner]] and his wife, photographer and producer [[Michele Singer Reiner]], were found dead with [[Penetrating trauma|multiple sharp force injuries]] at their home in [[Brentwood, Los Angeles|Brentwood]], a neighborhood in [[Los Angeles]], California. Their son, Nick Reiner, was arrested later that day on suspicion of murder. The case against him is ongoing. == Background == {{main|Rob Reiner|Michele Singer Reiner}} Rob Reiner was an American actor, director, and political activist. His credits include ''[[This Is Spinal Tap]]'', ''[[The Princess Bride (film)|The Princess Bride]]'', ''[[When Harry Met Sally...]]'', ''[[Misery (film)|Misery]]'', ''[[Stand by Me (film)|Stand by Me]]'', and ''[[A Few Good Men]]''.{{Cite news |last1=Leonard |first1=Eric |last2=Broad |first2=Dennis |last3=Kovacik |first3=Robert |last4=Klemack |first4=John Cádiz |date=December 14, 2025 |title=Rob Reiner, wife found dead with apparent stab wounds inside Brentwood home |url=https://www.nbclosangeles.com/investigations/2-found-dead-at-brentwood-mansion-owned-by-director-rob-reiner/3815886/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251225023934/https://www.nbclosangeles.com/investigations/2-found-dead-at-brentwood-mansion-owned-by-director-rob-reiner/3815886/ |archive-date=December 25, 2025 |website=NBC Los Angeles |language=en-US |access-date=December 16, 2025}} Michele Singer Reiner was a photographer, producer, and LGBTQ rights advocate.{{Cite news |last1=Schoenbaum |first1=Hannah |last2=Brumfield |first2=Sarah |date=December 16, 2025 |title=Michele Singer Reiner, photographer who inspired 1980s rom-com's happy end, dies |url=https://apnews.com/article/2760dfcd751244682fffee58b7ee2b29 |website=Associated Press |language=en-US |access-date=December 16, 2025}} Rob and Michele married in 1989 and had three children.{{Cite news |last=Sundby |first=Alex |date=December 15, 2025 |title=Nick Reiner, son of Rob Reiner and wife Michele, arrested for murder in their deaths, held without bail |url=https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nick-reiner-arrested-rob-reiner-michele/ |website=CBS News |language=en-US |access-date=December 16, 2025}} Rob also had an older adopted daughter, [[Tracy Reiner|Tracy]], whose mother was his former wife, [[Penny Marshall]]. Rob was 78 years old and Michele was 70 years old{{efn|News outlets reported her age as 68 and 70. The County of Los Angeles Medical Examiner's Office lists her age as 70.|name=birthyear}} at the time of their deaths. === Nick Reiner === [[File:Nick Reiner receives the 2016 Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration's 2016 SAMHSA Voice Awards (cropped 2).jpg|thumb|upright|Nick Reiner in 2016]] '''Nicholas Reiner''' (born September 14, 1993){{cite web |last1=Sommerlad |first1=Joe |date=December 17, 2025 |title=Nick Reiner's history of addiction and the movie his father Rob Reiner made about it years before fatal stabbing |url=https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/americas/crime/nick-reiner-rob-being-charlie-b2884818.html/ |work=The Independent |language=en-GB |access-date=December 18, 2025}} is the second of three children: he has an older brother, Jake, and a younger sister, Romy. He was born and raised in [[Los Angeles]]. He attended [[Wildwood School|Wildwood]], a private school in [[West Los Angeles]].{{Cite web |last1=Rosseinsky |first1=Katie |date=December 18, 2025 |title=The tragic truth about Nick Reiner and how his parents desperately tried to help him |url=https://www.the-independent.com/life-style/rob-reiner-death-son-nick-arrested-court-b2885660.html |website=The Independent |language=en-GB |access-date=December 31, 2025}} Reiner has a [[GED]] credential, but decided not to attend college.{{cite web |last1=Jacobs |first1=Julia |last2=Sperling |first2=Nicole |date=December 16, 2025 |title=Nick Reiner's Struggles With Drugs Left His Parents 'Desperate' |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/12/15/movies/nick-reiner-drugs-rehab-heroin-cocaine.html |website=The New York Times |language=en-US |access-date=December 19, 2025}} Before his arrest, Nick Reiner had discussed long-running [[Substance abuse|substance abuse problems]] in interviews and podcasts, including periods in and out of treatment beginning in his adolescence.{{Cite web |last1=Del Barco |first1=Mandalit |date=December 16, 2025 |title=Nick Reiner spoke openly about addiction before arrest |url=https://wbhm.org/npr-story/nick-reiner-spoke-openly-about-addiction-before-arrest/ |website=WBHM |language=en-US |access-date=December 16, 2025}} Nick's first stint at a [[drug rehab]] was when he was 14 years old. He shared a room at one of the treatment centers with a boy who was addicted to heroin, a drug that Nick would try in later years.{{cite news |last=Kaufman |first=Amy |date=January 24, 2026 |title=Inside Nick Reiner's life of privilege, pills and pain |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/style/2026/01/24/nick-reiner-profile/ |newspaper=The Washington Post |language=en-US |access-date=January 24, 2026}} ''[[The Irish Times]]'', summarizing prior public accounts, reported that Nick estimated he entered drug treatment eighteen times by the time he was 16, and spoke about addiction to [[heroin]] and [[cocaine]].{{Cite news |last1=Jacobs |first1=Julia |last2=Sperling |first2=Nicole |date=December 16, 2025 |title=Nick Reiner's struggles with drugs and homelessness left his parents 'desperate' |url=https://www.irishtimes.com/world/us/2025/12/16/nick-reiners-struggles-with-drugs-and-homelessness-left-his-parents-desperate/ |newspaper=The Irish Times |language=en-IE |access-date=December 16, 2025}} Rob Reiner said that reading [[David Sheff]]'s memoir ''[[Beautiful Boy: A Father's Journey Through His Son's Addiction]]'' educated him about his son's situation.{{Cite web |last=Zeitchik |first=Steven |date=December 16, 2025 |title=I Sat Down to Dinner With Rob, Michele and Nick Reiner. It Was Heartwarming and Jarring. |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/rob-reiner-nick-reiner-kill-home-1236451409/ |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en-US |access-date=January 1, 2026}} Nick had an often contentious relationship with his parents, who committed many resources toward his recovery. In 2015, Nick Reiner co-wrote the film ''[[Being Charlie]]'', which was inspired by his experiences with addiction and his relationship with his father, who directed the film. The film centered on an addict ([[Nick Robinson (American actor)|Nick Robinson]]) whose father ([[Cary Elwes]]) is a former actor turned politician.{{Cite news |last=Dalton |first=Andrew |date=December 16, 2025 |title=Rob Reiner once made a film with his son Nick, now suspected of killing parents |url=https://apnews.com/article/c90a79fe3ddaf2c419fbf5531619bb82 |website=Associated Press |language=en-US |access-date=December 16, 2025}} Despite the constant cycle of active addiction and stays in rehab centers, Nick reportedly became closer to his father during the production of ''Being Charlie''.{{cite news |last1=Anderson |first1=Eric |date=December 16, 2025 |title=Rob Reiner, Wife Michele 'Tried Everything' to Help Son Nick Before They Died in 'Nightmare' Murder (Exclusive Sources) |url=https://people.com/rob-reiner-wife-michele-tried-everything-help-son-nightmare-murder-exclusive-11869886 |website=People |language=en-US |access-date=December 16, 2025}} However, Nick suffered several relapses and police visited the Reiner home on many occasions over the following decade due to incidents involving him.{{cite news |last=Sainez |first=Brianna |date=December 23, 2025 |title=Rob Reiner Bombshell: Cops Visited Director's Home 'on Many Occasions' Over the Last Decade Before He Was Allegedly Murdered by Son Nick |url=https://okmagazine.com/p/cops-visited-rob-reiner-home-many-occasions-before-murders/ |website=OK! Magazine |language=en-US |access-date=December 25, 2025}}{{cite news |last=Onyewuchi |first=Chuckwudi |date=December 24, 2025 |title=Rob Reiner's Home Drew Repeated Police Visits Long Before The Fatal Night |url=https://theblast.com/756316/rob-reiners-home-repeated-police-visits-before-fatal-night/ |website=The Blast |language=en-US |access-date=December 25, 2025}} In a September 2025 interview with ''[[Fresh Air]]'', while Rob was promoting ''[[Spinal Tap II: The End Continues]],'' he said he believed his son was doing well. "He's been great … hasn't been doing drugs for over six years, he's in a really good place", Reiner said.https://www.npr.org/2025/12/16/nx-s1-5645138/rob-reiner-nick-reiner Nick was placed into a year-long [[Conservatorship|mental health conservatorship]] in 2020. The conservatorship ended in 2021.{{Cite news |last1=Arango |first1=Tim |last2=Jacobs |first2=Julia |last3=Barry |first3=Ellen |last4=Stevens |first4=Matt |date=January 15, 2026 |title=Nick Reiner Was in a Mental Health Conservatorship in 2020 |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/15/us/nick-reiner-conservatorship-schizophrenia.html |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |access-date=March 12, 2026}} At certain points, Nick was homeless, but at the time of their deaths, Nick was living with his parents. The night before Rob and Michele Reiner were discovered dead, the couple and Nick had attended a [[Christmas]] party hosted by [[Conan O'Brien]], but left after Nick, who reportedly "was freaking everyone out, acting crazy, [and] kept asking people if they were famous", got into a "very loud argument" with Rob.{{cite news |last1=Neumann |first1=Sean |last2=Bacher |first2=Danielle |date=December 15, 2025 |title=Rob Reiner and Son Nick 'Got in a Big Fight' at Conan O'Brien's Party Hours Before Murders: 'He Was Freaking Everyone Out' |url=https://people.com/rob-reiner-son-got-in-a-big-fight-conan-obrien-party-before-murders-sources-11869272 |work=People |language=en-US |access-date=December 16, 2025}} During the argument, Rob reportedly chastised his son for his conduct.{{Cite web |last1=Hubler |first1=Shawn |last2=Stevens |first2=Matt |date=December 16, 2025 |title=New Details Emerge About How Rob and Michele Reiner Were Found |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/12/16/us/reiner-family-rob-nick-michele.html |website=The New York Times |language=en-US |access-date=December 18, 2025}} Another associate of the Reiner family disputed the intensity of the argument and told ''[[The New York Times]]'' that the Reiners would not have left the party early due to Nick's behavior, which the family had grown accustomed to. == Killings and investigation == On the afternoon of December 14, 2025, Rob and Michele Reiner were due for a massage appointment and scheduled to have dinner with [[Barack Obama]] and [[Michelle Obama]]. The Reiners' massage therapist arrived at their [[Brentwood, Los Angeles|Brentwood]] home at 2:00PM, knocked on their door, rang the doorbell several times, then left after receiving no answer. Their daughter Romy, who lived right across the street, went to check on her parents, and discovered her father's body in the master bedroom.{{cite news |last1=Sangal |first1=Aditi |date=December 17, 2025 |title=What we know about the fatal stabbings of Rob and Michele Reiner and the case against their son |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2025/12/17/entertainment/rob-reiner-murder-case-what-we-know-hnk |website=CNN |language=en-US |access-date=December 20, 2025}} Her roommate [[911 (emergency telephone number)|called 911]] at 3:38 p.m. [[Pacific Time Zone|Pacific Standard Time]] after Romy fled the residence.{{Cite web |last1=Halpert |first1=Madeline |last2=Morris |first2=Regan |date=December 16, 2025 |title=Rob Reiner's son Nick arrested on suspicion of murder after director and wife found dead |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce8qnzd680ro |work=BBC News |language=en-GB |access-date=December 19, 2025}} Romy then contacted [[Billy Crystal]] and his wife Janice, close friends of the Reiner family, who arrived at the scene as emergency services were attending to the victims.{{Cite news |last=McLoughlin |first=Lisa |date=December 16, 2025 |title=Billy Crystal 'saw bodies of Rob Reiner and wife Michele' following double killing |url=https://www.standard.co.uk/showbiz/billy-crystal-saw-bodies-rob-reiner-wife-murder-b1262738.html |website=The Standard |language=en-GB |access-date=March 12, 2026}} Romy contacted her brother Jake, who was at [[Los Angeles Union Station|Union Station]] in [[Downtown Los Angeles]] attending a celebration of life event for a high school friend. Jake initially screened the call because he was in the middle of the event, but she called back immediately, which made him realize that something was wrong. When he answered, Romy told him that their father was dead, and then said that she couldn't find their mother. Jake immediately went into shock, and realized he needed to leave the station and get to his parents' home.{{Cite web|url=https://abc7.com/story/jake-reiners-1st-interview-parents-killings-brothers-arrest-moving-forward/19740616/|title=Jake Reiner’s 1st interview about his parents' killings, his brother's arrest, and moving forward|date=August 27, 2026|website=ABC7 Los Angeles}} [[Los Angeles Fire Department]] paramedics responding to the call found the Reiners dead inside the house. Romy and Jake were reportedly unaware of their mother's death before paramedics arrived. [[Los Angeles Police Department]] officers responded shortly afterward for what the department described as a death investigation that later developed into a homicide case.{{Cite news |last=Betts |first=Anna |date=December 16, 2025 |title=LA investigators expected to lay out case against Rob Reiner's son Nick |url=https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/dec/16/rob-reiner-nick-parents-murder-charge |website=The Guardian |language=en-GB |access-date=December 16, 2025}} The investigation was handled by the LAPD's robbery and homicide division, and police stated detectives were working to obtain a search warrant as part of the investigation. It was discovered that Nick had checked into room 207 at the Pierside [[Santa Monica]] hotel. Police searched the hotel for him, but he already left. Police also discovered that the shower Nick had used was full of blood; blood was also found on his bed mattress.{{Cite web|url=https://nypost.com/2025/12/24/us-news/nick-reiner-hunkered-down-amid-sweeping-priceless-seaside-views-allegedly-after-killing-parents-rob-and-michele/|title=Nick Reiner hunkered down in trendy hotel with sweeping priceless seaside views allegedly after killing parents Rob and Michele|date=December 24, 2025}} Hours before his arrest, [[closed-circuit television|CCTV]] footage captured Nick entering an Arco gas station near Exposition Park in [[South Los Angeles]], 15 miles east of the hotel. He was wearing a backpack, and bought an energy drink. {{short description|Chilean politician (born 1993)}} {{for|his father, President of Chile|José Antonio Kast}} {{family name hatnote|Kast|Adriasola|lang=Chilean}} {{use dmy dates|date=November 2025}} {{Infobox officeholder | name = José Antonio Kast Adriasola | image = José Antonio Kast Adriasola diputado 2026 (retrato 2).jpg | caption = Official portrait, 2026 | office = Member of the [[Chamber of Deputies of Chile|Chamber of Deputies]] | term_start = 11 March 2026 | term_end = | predecessor = [[Johannes Kaiser (Chilean politician)|Johannes Kaiser]] | constituency = [[District 10 (Chamber of Deputies of Chile)|District 10]] | party = [[Republican Party of Chile|Republican]] | other_party = | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1993|04|21|df=y }} | birth_place = [[Paine, Chile|Paine]], Chile | father = [[José Antonio Kast]] | mother = [[Pía Adriasola]] | education = [[Pontifical Catholic University of Chile]]
[[University of the Andes, Chile|University of the Andes]]
[[University of Chicago]] | occupation = [[Politician]] | profession = [[Lawyer]] | relatives = {{Plainlist| * [[Michael Kast]] (grandfather) * [[Miguel Kast]] (uncle) * [[Pablo Kast|Pablo]], [[Felipe Kast|Felipe]] and [[Tomás Kast]] (cousins) }} }} '''José Antonio Kast Adriasola''' (born 21 April 1993) is a Chilean politician serving as a member of the [[Chamber of Deputies of Chile|Chamber of Deputies]] since 2026, representing District 10 of the [[Santiago Metropolitan Region]].{{cite web|url=https://www.24horas.cl/elecciones/elecciones-2025-como-le-ha-ido-en-votos-a-jose-antonio-kast-adriasola|title=José Antonio Kast Adriasola es electo diputado en las elecciones parlamentarias 2025|work=[[24 horas (Chilean TV program)|24 horas]]|date=16 November 2025|language=es}} He is the son of incumbent president, [[José Antonio Kast]].{{cite web|url=https://elpais.com/chile/2025-09-06/jose-antonio-kast-adriasola-tras-los-pasos-politicos-de-su-padre.html|title=El hijo de Kast, 'Toño': cuando la piña en la pizza es tu rasgo más liberal|work=[[El País]]|date=7 September 2025|language=es}} ==Biography== He is the second of nine children of the marriage between Chilean politician [[José Antonio Kast Rist]] and [[Pía Adriasola]], a lawyer.{{cite web |url=https://www.ex-ante.cl/quien-es-jose-antonio-kast-adriasola-el-hijo-del-candidato-presidencial-que-postula-a-diputado/ |title=Quién es José Antonio Kast Adriasola, el hijo del candidato presidencial que postula a diputado |last=Astudillo |first=Benjamín |date=2025-09-02 |website=Ex-Ante |access-date=18 November 2025}} His father comes from a family of German origin and is [[Catholic Church|Catholic]]—his parents were [[Bavarians|Bavarian]] immigrants—and has publicly declared his faith and traditional family values.{{cite web |url=https://elpais.com/chile/2025-05-04/matthei-winter-kast-y-kaiser-la-huella-alemana-en-las-presidenciales-chilenas.html |title=Matthei, Winter, Kast y Kaiser: la huella alemana en las presidenciales chilenas |last=Laborde |first=Antonia |date=2025-05-04 |website=El País Chile |language=es |access-date=18 November 2025}} The Kast–Adriasola family is close to the [[Schönstatt Movement|Schönstatt Apostolic Movement]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/mundo/articles/cx2y5k5704po |title=José Antonio Kast, el ultraderechista que busca aglutinar el voto de oposición y ser presidente de Chile al tercer intento |last=Lissardy |first=Gerardo |date=2025-11-17 |website=BBC News Mundo |access-date=19 November 2025}} Kast Adriasola has followed an independent political trajectory. He studied law at the [[Pontifical Catholic University of Chile]], where he served as a teaching assistant in procedural law. He later completed a master's degree in philosophy at the [[University of the Andes, Chile|University of the Andes]] and subsequently pursued studies in [[public policy]] at the [[University of Chicago]] in the [[United States]]. He has participated in political campaigns, led the NGO ''Influyamos'', and assumed strategic roles within the Republican Party, maintaining [[Social conservatism|socially conservative]] positions on issues such as [[Abortion in Chile|abortion]], [[Cannabis in Chile|cannabis use]], and [[sex education]].{{cite web |url=https://elpais.com/chile/2025-09-06/jose-antonio-kast-adriasola-tras-los-pasos-politicos-de-su-padre.html |title=El hijo de Kast, 'Toño': cuando la piña en la pizza es tu rasgo más liberal |last=Laborde |first=Antonia |date=2025-09-07 |website=El País Chile |access-date=18 November 2025}} In 2020, Kast Adriasola was announced as a candidate for mayor of [[San Bernardo, Chile|San Bernardo]], resigning from his position at a law firm to dedicate himself to the campaign.{{cite web |url=https://www.elmostrador.cl/dia/2020/12/09/dinastia-kast-busca-extenderse-hijo-del-lider-del-partido-republicano-sera-candidato-a-alcalde-por-san-bernardo/ |title=Dinastía Kast busca extenderse: hijo del líder del Partido Republicano será candidato a alcalde por San Bernardo |date=2020-12-09 |website=El Mostrador |language=es |access-date=18 November 2025}} However, he ultimately withdrew his candidacy in January 2021, arguing that with another right-wing candidate competing, it would not be possible to consolidate a victory.{{cite web |url=https://www.cnnchile.com/pais/hijo-kast-renuncio-candidatura-alcaldia-san-bernardo_20210112/ |title=Hijo de Kast bajó su candidatura a la alcaldía de San Bernardo: “Fue una decisión difícil, pero creo que es lo mejor” |website=CNN Chile |access-date=18 November 2025}} He later assumed a strategic role within the Republican Party. In 2024, he served as coordinator of the party's municipal campaigns in the [[Santiago Metropolitan Region|Metropolitan Region]].{{cite web |url=https://www.biobiochile.cl/noticias/nacional/chile/2024/08/27/hijo-de-kast-coordinara-a-los-candidatos-republicanos-de-la-metropolitana-en-las-proximas-municipales.shtml |title=Hijo de Kast coordinará a los candidatos republicanos de la Metropolitana en las próximas municipales |last=Barra |first=María José de la |date=2024-08-27 |website=Radio Bío-Bío |language=es |access-date=18 November 2025}} In 2025, in his first formal electoral bid, he ran as a candidate for the [[Chamber of Deputies of Chile]] for District 10, receiving public support from his father, José Antonio Kast.{{cite web |url=https://www.publimetro.cl/noticias/2025/08/25/jose-antonio-kast-defendio-la-candidatura-a-diputado-de-su-hijo-del-mismo-nombre-no-es-un-cargo-de-designacion-personal/ |title=José Antonio Kast defendió la candidatura a diputado de su hijo del mismo nombre: “No es un cargo de designación personal” |last=Núñez |first=María Paz |date=2025-08-25 |website=Publimetro Chile |language=es |access-date=18 November 2025}} ==References== {{reflist|2}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Kast Adriasola, Jose Antonio}} [[Category:1993 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Republican Party (Chile, 2019) politicians]] [[Category:Deputies of the LVII Legislative Period of the National Congress of Chile]] [[Category:Kast family|José Antonio]] [[Category:Pontifical Catholic University of Chile alumni]] [[Category:University of the Andes, Chile alumni]] [[Category:University of Chicago alumni]] [[Category:Children of presidents of Chile]]

{{short description|American politician}} {{Infobox officeholder | name = Anastasios Kamoutsas | image = Anastasios Kamoutsas portrait (cropped).jpg | caption = Official portrait, 2025 | term_start = July 6, 2026 | term_end = | predecessor = Anne Kerr (interim) | preceded = | status = | succeeded = | succeeding = | term_end1 = July 6, 2026 | term_start2 = August 2023 | term_end2 = July 2025 | succeeding1 = | successor1 = Henry Mack | term_start1 = July 13, 2025 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1988|6|10}} | birth_place = [[Los Angeles County]], [[California]], U.S. | death_date = | death_place = | education = [[Florida International University]] ([[Bachelor of Arts|BA]])
[[Regent University School of Law|Regent University]] ([[Juris Doctor|JD]]) | spouse = Rachel Kamoutsas | children = 4 | profession = {{hlist|Lawyer}} | party = [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] | governor1 = [[Ron DeSantis]] | office1 = 29th [[Florida Department of Education|Education Commissioner of Florida]] | preceded1 = [[Manny Díaz Jr.]] | office = 6th President of [[Polk State College]] | governor = | governor2 = Ron DeSantis | office2 = Deputy Chief of Staff to the [[Governor of Florida]] }} '''Anastasios Ioannis "Stasi" Kamoutsas''' (born June 10, 1988) is an American lawyer who is currently the President of [[Polk State College]]. A [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]], Kamoutsas was previously deputy chief of staff to Florida governor [[Ron DeSantis]] and [[Florida Department of Education|education commissioner of Florida]]. ==Background== Kamoutsas was born in [[Los Angeles County]], [[California]].{{cite web |title=California Birth Index|url=https://californiabirthindex.org/birth/anastasios_ioannis_kamoutsas_born_1988_18610103 |access-date=5 December 2025}} He graduated from [[Miami Springs High School]], and attended [[Florida International University]], where he graduated with a degree in political science. He then attended [[Regent University School of Law]], graduating with a [[Juris Doctor]] in 2014. ==Legal career== Kamoutsas was admitted to the Florida Bar in 2014. His first two jobs were Assistant State Attorney for the [[Miami-Dade]] Office of the State Attorney and Counsel to the [[Miami-Dade County|Dade County]] [[Police Benevolent Association]]. In 2018, Kamoutsas ran unsuccessfully for a seat on the Miami-Dade Community Council.{{cite web |title=2018 Results |url=https://enr.electionsfl.org/DAD/2992/Precincts/40344/ |website=Elections Florida}} ==Political career== === Aide to Education Commissioner === In 2019, while [[Richard Corcoran]] was Commissioner, Kamoutsas joined the Florida Department of Education’s Office of General Counsel.{{cite web |title=Commissioner Anastasios Kamoutsas |url=https://www.fldoe.org/about-us/commissioner.stml |website=Florida Department of Education |access-date=5 December 2025}} One of his notable tasks was managing the legal fallout from Department efforts to defund districts with Covid mask mandates.{{cite news |last1=Brown |first1=Danielle J. |title=FL Education Department under federal scrutiny; retains lawyer over cease-and-desist complaint |url=https://floridaphoenix.com/2021/11/16/fl-education-department-under-federal-scrutiny-retains-lawyer-over-cease-and-desist-complaint/ |work=Florida Phoenix |date=November 16, 2021}} === Deputy Chief of Staff for DeSantis === In August 2023, Kamoutsas was appointed deputy Chief of Staff to Governor Ron DeSantis.{{cite news |title=New Deputy Chiefs of Staff, other lieutenants named in Ron DeSantis' administration |url=https://floridapolitics.com/archives/627271-new-deputy-chiefs-of-staff-other-lieutenants-named-in-ron-desantis-administration/ |access-date=5 December 2025 |work=Florida Politics |date=August 7, 2023}} He played an instrumental role in alleged retaliation against two [[Florida Department of Law Enforcement]] officials who disagreed with the Governor's office concerning records of publicly-funded travel by DeSantis during his [[Ron DeSantis 2024 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]].{{cite news |title=DeSantis staffers blocked release of travel records, whistleblower says |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2023/12/13/desantis-travel-records-florida-officials-clash-post-lawsuit/ |work=Washington Post |date=December 13, 2013}}{{cite news |last1=Fineout |first1=Gary |title=Florida investigated 2 former employees involved in Washington Post records lawsuit |url=https://www.politico.com/news/2024/06/06/florida-desantis-whistleblower-lawsuit-00162180 |access-date=5 December 2025 |work=Politico |date=June 6, 2024}} === Florida Education Commissioner === In He became the German Youth Champion in 2010 at the age of 17. That year, his consistently strong performances at DDV tournaments also propelled him to the number one spot in the German youth rankings. In the 2010 World Masters he lost to Martin Heneghan in the first round match. At the end of season, he qualified for the [[2011 BDO World Darts Championship]].{{cite web |last=Hobbs |first=Louis |date=11 December 2025 |title=World Darts Championship 2026: Arno Merk Opens Up on Emotional Redemption After Five-Year Hiatus|url=https://www.sportsboom.co.uk/darts/world-darts-championship/arno-merk-emotional-redemption-after-five-year-hiatus |website=sportsboom.com |access-date=}} In the first round, he lost to Garry Thompson. He made his return to competition in the German Super League in 2023, where he was eliminated in the second round by Pascal Rupprecht. At the beginning of 2024, Merk played in the PDC Qualifying School, but he was unable to secure a Tour Card and subsequently competed on the PDC Challenge Tour. In April 2024, he qualified for the [[2024 European Darts Grand Prix]], making his PDC European Tour debut. Merk lost in the first round to [[Luke Littler]]. He then participated in the 2024 World Masters, but he lost in group-stage. At the German Super League in 2024, Merk was again eliminated in the second round. In March 2025, Merk reached his first PDC Challenge Tour event quarter-final. As a call-up, he reached the third round of [[2025 PDC Players Championship series#Players Championship 22|Players Championship 22]]. He also played in the PDC Europe Next-Gen season, winning the last two events and qualifying for the German Super League once again. There, Merk defeated Daniel Klose in the final and qualified for the [[2026 PDC World Darts Championship]].{{cite web |date=3 December 2025 |title=Dart WM 2026: Arno Merk – Als Super League Champion [[University of Florida]] (MBA) | spouse = Alexandria "Alex" Ayala-Long | occupation = Engineer }} '''Rob Long''' (born January 13, 1985) is a [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] politician who has served as a member of the [[Florida House of Representatives]] from the [[Florida's 90th House of Representatives district|90th district]] since 2025. ==Early life== Long was born in [[Gaithersburg, Maryland]], and attended [[Pennsylvania State University]], receiving his [[bachelor's degree]] in civil engineering in 2008. He moved to [[Florida]] in 2008, and attended the [[University of Florida]], where he graduated with his [[master of business administration]] in 2010.{{cite web|title=Rob Long|date=|url=https://www.flhouse.gov/Sections/Representatives/details.aspx?MemberId=5067&LegislativeTermId=91|website=Florida House of Representatives|access-date=February 14, 2026}} In 2016, Long ran for the [[Palm Beach County, Florida#Government|Palm Beach County]] Soil and Water Conservation District in Group 4 against incumbent Supervisor Dave Self. During the campaign, several political action committees sent mailers in support of Libertarian Karl Dickey, one of Long's opponents.{{cite news|last=Kleinberg|first=Eliot|title=What’s with PAC ads in obscure PBC conservation board races this year?|newspaper=[[The Palm Beach Post]]|date=November 24, 2016|location=[[West Palm Beach, Florida]]|url=https://www.palmbeachpost.com/story/news/politics/2016/11/23/what-s-with-pac-ads/6867840007/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220117162726/https://www.palmbeachpost.com/story/news/politics/2016/11/23/what-s-with-pac-ads/6867840007/|archive-date=January 17, 2022|access-date=February 14, 2026}} Long won the election by a wide margin, receiving 48 percent of the vote to Dickey's 33 percent and Self's 19 percent.{{cite web|title=2016 General Election|date=October 30, 2019|url=https://enr.electionsfl.org/PAL/2460/Summary/|website=Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections|access-date=February 14, 2026}} Long ran for re-election in 2020 and was challenged by businesswoman Candace Rojas.{{cite news|last=Miller|first=Kimberly|title=Little known board on ballot helps preserves wetlands, assists farmers and aids water conservation efforts|newspaper=[[The Palm Beach Post]]|date=October 23, 2020|location=[[West Palm Beach, Florida]]|url=https://www.palmbeachpost.com/story/news/2020/10/23/soil-and-water-conservation-district-has-three-seats-up-grabs/6003929002/|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210724172510/https://www.palmbeachpost.com/story/news/2020/10/23/soil-and-water-conservation-district-has-three-seats-up-grabs/6003929002/|archive-date=July 24, 2021|access-date=February 14, 2026}} He was ultimately re-elected, winning 54 percent of the vote to Rojas's 46 percent.{{cite web|title=2020 General Election|date=November 23, 2020|url=https://enr.electionsfl.org/PAL/2801/Summary/|website=Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections|access-date=February 14, 2026}} Long served on [[Delray Beach, Florida|Delray Beach]] Planning and Zoning Board, and attracted criticism from the City Commission for criticizing the city's water quality. Though the City Commission had suggested that it might remove him from the Board for his comments, it ultimately did not do so.{{cite news|last=Diamond|first=Mike|title=Delray officials blast planning board member for city water criticism but don't move to oust him|newspaper=[[The Palm Beach Post]]|date=December 2, 2020|location=[[West Palm Beach, Florida]]|url=https://www.palmbeachpost.com/story/news/2020/12/02/delray-officials-blast-board-member-but-dont-move-oust-him/3796052001/|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210124102952/https://www.palmbeachpost.com/story/news/2020/12/02/delray-officials-blast-board-member-but-dont-move-oust-him/3796052001/|archive-date=January 24, 2021|access-date=February 14, 2026}} In 2023, Long ran for the [[Delray Beach, Florida|Delray Beach]] City Commission, challenging incumbent City Commissioner Juli Casale.{{cite news|last=Travis|first=Scott|title=Election fight showing city's uglier side|newspaper=[[Sun Sentinel]]|date=March 5, 2023|location=[[Fort Lauderdale, Florida]]|page=A1|url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/south-florida-sun-sentinel/191313749/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]|access-date=February 14, 2026}} Long narrowly defeated Casale,{{cite web|last=Geggis|first=Anne|title=Delray Beach City Commissioner ousted; newcomer wins over former Commissioner|date=March 15, 2023|url=https://floridapolitics.com/archives/595398-delray-beach-city-commissioner-ousted-newcomer-wins-over-former-commissioner/|website=Florida Politics|access-date=February 14, 2026}} winning 53 percent of the vote to her 47 percent.{{cite web|title=2023 Uniform Municipal Elections|date=March 16, 2023|url=https://enr.electionsfl.org/PAL/Summary/3368/|website=Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections|access-date=February 14, 2026}} ==Florida House of Representatives== Long announced on February 11, 2025, that he would run to succeed Democratic State Representative [[Joseph Casello]] in the [[Florida's 90th House of Representatives district|90th district]] in the [[Florida House of Representatives]], winning Casello's endorsement.{{cite web|last=Scheckner|first=Jesse|title='People over politics': Rob Long launches bid for HD 90 with bevy of endorsements|date=February 11, 2025|url=https://floridapolitics.com/archives/720512-people-over-politics-rob-long-launches-bid-for-hd-90-with-bevy-of-endorsements/|website=Florida Politics|access-date=February 14, 2026}} On July 18, 2025, Casello died, triggering a special election.{{cite web|title='Gentle giant' Joe Casello dies at 73|date=July 19, 2025|url=https://floridapolitics.com/archives/747884-gentle-giant-joe-casello-dies-at-73/|website=Florida Politics|access-date=February 14, 2026}} Long received endorsements from the local Democratic Party establishment,{{cite web|last=Scheckner|first=Jesse|title=Palm Beach County Democrats unite behind Rob Long in Special Election for HD 90|date=July 23, 2025|url=https://floridapolitics.com/archives/748472-palm-beach-county-democrats-unite-behind-rob-long-in-special-election-for-hd-90/|website=Florida Politics|access-date=February 14, 2026}} and ultimately won the Democratic nomination unopposed. He faced [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] nominee Maria Zack, a lobbyist and conspiracy theorist,{{cite news|last=Man|first=Anthony|title=Activist who argues 2020 election was stolen from Trump runs for Florida Legislature|newspaper=[[Sun Sentinel]]|date=September 19, 2025|location=[[Fort Lauderdale, Florida]]|url=https://www.sun-sentinel.com/2025/09/19/activist-who-argues-2020-election-was-stolen-from-trump-runs-for-florida-legislature/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250919212423/https://www.sun-sentinel.com/2025/09/19/activist-who-argues-2020-election-was-stolen-from-trump-runs-for-florida-legislature/|archive-date=September 19, 2025|access-date=February 14, 2026}} in the general election, along with [[independent (politician)|independent]] candidate Karen Yeh.{{cite web|last=Scheckner|first=Jesse|title=Rob Long, Maria Zack face off Tuesday in HD 90 Special Election|date=December 8, 2025|url=https://floridapolitics.com/archives/768703-rob-long-maria-zack-face-off-tuesday-in-hd-90-special-election/|website=Florida Politics|access-date=February 14, 2026}} Long won the election in a landslide, receiving 63 percent of the vote to Zack's 36 percent and Yeh's 1 percent.{{cite web|title=2025 Special General Election HD90|date=December 19, 2025|url=https://enr.electionsfl.org/PAL/3897/Summary/|website=Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections|access-date=February 14, 2026}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Florida == Career ==

In a 2023 report by the [[Associated Press]] that was republished by multiple outlets, McLaughlin said that efforts by [[Party leaders of the United States House of Representatives|Democratic leaders]] to restrict firearms would embolden [[criminals]] and reiterated that the NRA would continue to advocate for self-defense laws.<ref>{{cite news

'''Jordi Cano Jiménez''' (born 1 April 1995) is a Spanish professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Forward (association football)|forward]] for {{Spanish football updater|Andorra}} club [[FC Andorra]].

==Club career==
Born in [[Barcelona]], [[Catalonia]], Cano played for [[RCD Espanyol]], [[UE Cornellà]] and [[CE Europa]] as a youth. After making his senior debut with [[Segona Catalana]] side UD Vista Alegre in 2014, he returned to Europa in June 2016, now for the first team in [[Tercera División]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://beteve.cat/esports/xavi-civil-i-jordi-cano-reforcos-de-luxe-per-al-ce-europa/|title=Xavi Civil i Jordi Cano, reforços de luxe per al CE Europa|trans-title=Xavi Civil and Jordi Cano, luxury additions for CE Europa|publisher=Betevé|language=ca|date=16 June 2016|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref>

[[File:CE Europa - UE Sant Andreu (49334548267) - Jordi Cano.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Cano playing with [[CE Europa|Europa]] in 2020]]
Cano left for fellow fourth division side [[UE Castelldefels]] on 23 November 2016,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uecastelldefels.com/primer-equip/noticies/item/1660-moviments-plantilla-ue-castelldefels-arriben-david-bauli-ex-ce-j%C3%BApiter-i-jordi-cano-ce-europa.html|title=MOVIMENTS PLANTILLA UE CASTELLDEFELS: ARRIBEN DAVID BAULI (ex CE Júpiter) i JORDI CANO (CE Europa)|trans-title=MOVEMENTS UE CASTELLDEFELS SQUAD: DAVID BAULI (formerly of CE Júpiter) and JORDI CANO (CE Europa) ARRIVE|publisher=UE Castelldefels|language=ca|date=23 November 2016|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref> before moving to [[AE Prat]] in August of the following year.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vavel.com/es/futbol/2017/08/14/tercera-division/817240-los-cano-cumplen-un-sueno-en-el-prat.html|title=Los Cano cumplen un sueño en el Prat|trans-title=The Canos fulfill a dream at Prat|publisher=Vavel|language=es|date=14 August 2017|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref> Back to his previous club on 30 May 2018,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uecastelldefels.com/primer-equip/noticies/item/3614-jordi-cano-prat-i-rub%C3%A9n-cruz-rubi-santboi%C3%A0-,-primers-fitxatges-presentats-ue-castelldefels-18-19.html|title=JORDI CANO (Prat) i RUBÉN CRUZ 'RUBI' (Santboià), PRIMERS FITXATGES PRESENTATS UE CASTELLDEFELS 18–19|trans-title=JORDI CANO (Prat) and RUBÉN CRUZ 'RUBI' (Santboià), FIRST SIGNINGS PRESENTED OF UE CASTELLDEFELS 18–19|publisher=UE Castelldefels|language=ca|date=30 May 2018|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref> he subsequently returned to Europa on 24 May 2019.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ceeuropa.cat/component/k2/jordi-cano-torna-a-l-europa|title=Jordi Cano torna a l'Europa|trans-title=Jordi Cano returns to Europa|publisher=CE Europa|language=ca|date=24 May 2019|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref>

Cano was the top scorer of the ''Escapulats'' during the [[2019–20 Tercera División|2019–20 season]], scoring 18 goals, before leaving for [[Segunda División B]] side [[CF Badalona]] on 24 July 2020.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://beteve.cat/esports/jordi-cano-marxa-ce-europa-segona-divisio-b-2020/|title=Jordi Cano deixa l’Europa per jugar amb el Badalona a la Segona Divisió B|trans-title=Jordi Cano leaves Europa to play for Badalona in Segunda División B|publisher=Betevé|language=ca|date=24 July 2020|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref> Rarely used, he moved to fellow league team [[CE L'Hospitalet]] on 27 January 2021,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.celh.es/es/jordi-cano-refuerzo-de-invierno-para-la-plantilla-riberena/|title=Jordi Cano, refuerzo de invierno para la plantilla ribereña|trans-title=Jordi Cano, winter addition for the ''ribereña'' squad|publisher=CE L'Hospitalet|language=es|date=27 January 2021|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref> before again returned to Europa on 18 June 2021, with the club now in [[Segunda División RFEF]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ceeuropa.cat/qui-som/jordi-cano-torna-de-nou-a-casa|title=Jordi Cano torna de nou a casa!|trans-title=Jordi Cano returns home again!|publisher=CE Europa|language=ca|date=18 June 2021|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref>

On 4 January 2022, Cano agreed to a deal with [[SD Huesca]], being assigned to [[SD Huesca B|the reserves]] also in the fourth division.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sdhuesca.es/noticias/jordi-cano-se-suma-al-ataque-de-la-sd-huesca-b|title=Jordi Cano se suma al ataque de la SD Huesca B|trans-title=Jordi Cano joins the attack of SD Huesca B|publisher=SD Huesca|language=es|date=4 January 2022|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref> After [[2021–22 Segunda División RFEF|suffering relegation]], he signed for [[Terrassa FC]] of the same category.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.terrassafc.com/noticies/terrassa-fc/item/1303-l-extrem-jordi-cano-primer-fitxatge-bomba-del-terrassa-fc|title=L’extrem Jordi Cano, primer fitxatge bomba del Terrassa FC|trans-title=The winger Jordi Cano, Terrassa FC's first signing|publisher=Terrassa FC|language=ca|date=27 May 2022|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref>

On 7 June 2023, after scoring 11 goals during [[2022–23 Segunda Federación|the campaign]], Cano renewed his contract with the ''Egarencs'' for two further years.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.terrassafc.com/noticies/terrassa-fc/item/1600-jordi-cano-2025-el-pitxitxi-renova-per-dues-temporades|title=Jordi Cano 2025: el ‘pitxitxi’ renova per dues temporades|trans-title=Jordi Cano 2025: The 'Pichichi' renews for two seasons|publisher=Terrassa FC|language=ca|date=7 June 2023|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref> He rejoined Europa for a third senior spell on 18 June 2024,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://beteve.cat/esports/jordi-cano-torna-europa-reforcar-atac-escapulat/|title=Jordi Cano torna a l’Europa per reforçar l’atac escapulat|trans-title=Jordi Cano returns to Europa to bolster the ''escapulat'' attack|publisher=Betevé|language=ca|date=18 June 2024|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref> and scored a career-best during [[2024–25 Segunda Federación|the season]] as the club achieved promotion to [[Primera Federación]].

After completing an excellent [[2025–26 Primera Federación|2025–26 season]], during which he was the third division top scorer with 25 goals, Cano signed a two-year contract with [[Segunda División]] side [[FC Andorra]] on 14 July 2026.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/en/news/jordi-cano-new-tricolor-signing|title=Jordi Cano, new tricolor signing|publisher=FC Andorra|date=14 July 2026|accessdate=14 July 2026}}</ref> He made his professional debut at the age of 31 on 15 August, starting and scoring the opener in a 5–1 home routing of [[AD Ceuta FC]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/andorra/2026/08/19/nunca-tarde-debut-sonado-31-anos.html|title=Nunca es tarde: debut soñado con 31 años|trans-title=It is never too late: dream debut at the age of 31|publisher=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|language=es|date=19 August 2026|accessdate=19 August 2026}}</ref>

==International career==
On 14 November 2025, Cano and his brother were called up to the [[Catalonia national football team|Catalonia national team]] for a friendly against [[Palestine national football team|Palestine]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://beteve.cat/esports/alex-jordi-cano-europa-albertito-sant-andreu-convocats-catalunya/|title=Àlex i Jordi Cano i Albertito, convocats amb Catalunya|trans-title=Àlex and Jordi Cano and Albertito, called up with Catalonia|publisher=Betevé|language=ca|date=14 November 2025|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref> He made his international debut four days later, playing the entire second half in the 2–1 win at the [[Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ghrv.cat/alex-cano-jordi-cano-i-arnau-campeny-fan-historia-amb-catalunya/|title=Àlex Cano, Jordi Cano i Arnau Campeny fan història amb Catalunya|trans-title=Àlex Cano, Jordi Cano and Arnau Campeny make history with Catalonia|publisher=Grupo d'Historia Ramon Vergés|language=ca|date=19 November 2025|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Cano comes from a family of footballers: his older brothers [[Àlex Cano|Àlex]] and [[Carlos Cano Jiménez|Carlos]] are also footballers, with the former being a [[centre-back]] and the latter being a [[Forward (association football)|forward]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://futbolcatalunya.com/la-familia-cano-guanya-al-nou-sardenya/|title=La família Cano guanya al Nou Sardenya|trans-title=The Cano family wins at Nou Sardenya|publisher=Futbol Catalunya|language=ca|date=14 September 2017|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref> Jordi and Carlos played together at Prat, and faced Àlex (at the time at Europa) in September 2017, in a match where all three brothers scored.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.es/deportes/futbol/abci-curiosa-noche-familia-cano-europa-prat-201709140828_noticia.html|title=La curiosa noche de la familia Cano en el Europa-Prat|trans-title=The curious night of the Cano family at Europa-Prat|publisher=[[ABC (newspaper)|ABC]]|language=es|date=14 September 2017|accessdate=27 January 2026}}</ref>

'''Tyler Hudson''' (born October 28, 1995), better known as '''BBY Goyard''', is an American rapper. Hudson has been credited with influencing the [[Hip-hop|rap]] scene with his sped-up and [[Pitch (music)|pitched]]-up vocal style, revitalizing [[DJ mix|DJ tags]] and popularizing the word "lore" in modern vernacular.<ref name="repeat">{{Cite web |date=March 4, 2025 |title=BBY GOYARD is On Repeat |url=https://www.wonderlandmagazine.com/2025/03/04/bby-goyard-on-repeat/ |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=Wonderland |language=en-GB}}</ref>

==Early life==
Tyler Hudson<ref name="frith">{{Cite web |last=Frith |first=Holly |date=2020-02-18 |title=BBY Goyard Is Effortlessly Cool With BACKIN’ IT UP – FM famemagazine.co.uk |url=https://www.famemagazine.co.uk/bby-goyard-is-effortlessly-cool-with-backin-it-up/ |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=www.famemagazine.co.uk}}</ref> was born on October 28, 1995, in [[Maryland]].<ref name="montes">{{Cite web |last=Montes |first=Patrick |date=April 12, 2019 |title=BBY GOYARD Focuses on Wordplay & Lyricism for New Single "THE LOUVRE" |url=https://hypebeast.com/2019/4/bby-goyard-the-louvre-song-stream |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=Hypebeast}}</ref> After graduating high school, he briefly worked as a pizza deliveryman until moving to [[North Carolina]] and beginning to make music at 18.<ref name="gendron"/>

==Career==
[[File:BBY Goyard - Human Instincts 2018.png|thumb|BBY Goyard in a 2018 music video]]
Goyard released his debut EP, ''Depth Perception'', on April 25, 2019. When describing one of its singles, "The Louvre", Goyard explained that he wanted to create a "nostalgic feeling" and make the song sound "fun yet gritty at the same time".<ref name="montes"/> He wanted to incorporate 90's cultural references to invoke introspection and inspire them to dig deeper.<ref name="gendron">{{Cite web |last=Gendron |first=Will |date=2019-04-26 |title=BBY Goyard is here to disrupt |url=https://www.thefader.com/2019/04/26/bby-goyard-is-here-to-disrupt |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=The FADER |language=en}}</ref>

In 2024, Goyard went on tour with the [[black metal]] band [[Portrayal of Guilt]]. The experience inspired him to release the album ''Tastemaker'' in 2025, themed after [[Dante Alighieri|Dante]]'s ''[[Inferno (Dante)|Inferno]]'' and blending 2000s punk, grunge, and alternative with cloud rap.<ref name="repeat"/><ref name="dw">{{Cite web |date=March 6, 2025 |title=Genre-bending BBY GOYARD drops off brand new album 'TASTEMAKER' |url=https://dancewax.net/2025/03/06/genre-bending-bby-goyard-drops-off-brand-new-album-tastemaker/ |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=Dance Wax |language=en-GB}}</ref>

==Musical style and artistry==
Hudson has stated that he is influenced by artists such as [[Chief Keef]], [[Soulja Boy]], and the band [[All Time Low]], in addition to the genres of [[screamo]] and [[pop punk]].<ref name="wonderland">{{Cite web |date=February 14, 2020 |title=American rapper BBY GOYARD premieres “Backin’ It Up” |url=https://www.wonderlandmagazine.com/2020/02/14/premiere-bby-goyard-backin/ |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=Wonderland |language=en-GB}}</ref> Goyard stated that his favorite album of all time was ''[[I Brought You My Bullets, You Brought Me Your Love]]'' by [[My Chemical Romance]].<ref name="repeat"/> In his songs, he pitches and speeds up his voice, often over [[breakbeat]] production.<ref name="gendron"/><ref name="pierre">{{Cite web |last=Pierre |first=Alphonse |date=June 4, 2021 |title=Trippie Redd, Travis Scott, Kid Cudi, and the Commodification of Rage in Rap |url=https://pitchfork.com/thepitch/trippie-redd-travis-scott-kid-cudi-commodification-of-rage-in-rap/ |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=Pitchfork |language=en-US}}</ref> Describing Goyard's 2019 single, "Tarot Card", Will Gendron of ''[[The Fader]]'' described its instrumental as "electro [[Zaytoven]]".<ref name="tarot">{{Cite web |last=Gendron |first=Will |date=2019-07-12 |title=BBY Goyard embodies a phantom on his latest single |url=https://www.thefader.com/2019/07/12/bby-goyard-releases-new-single-tarot-card |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=The FADER |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Corcoran |first=Nina |date=2022-03-20 |title=Goonew, Maryland Rapper, Shot Dead at 24 |url=https://pitchfork.com/news/goonew-maryland-rapper-shot-dead-at-24/ |access-date=2026-04-10 |website=Pitchfork |language=en-US}}</ref>
